messages:
mira: quick heads-up — opened PR to clarify SDK streaming examples for backpressure + retries. includes py/ts/go. please skim for accuracy. :eyes:
adrian: on it. is this mostly doc wording or are we changing recommended patterns?
mira: both. small code changes to show abort/timeout + explicit example for pagination with streaming responses. also mention jittered retries for transient 5xx.
kai: fyi the TS snippet needs an AbortSignal example — folks hit memory growth if they don't cancel long-lived streams. proposed patch below:
```ts
const controller = new AbortController();
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-large', messages });
setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 60000); // backpressure/timebox
for await (const chunk of stream.stream({ signal: controller.signal })) {
  // handle chunk
}
```
jen: for Python we should show both sync and async variants. sync users often try to buffer everything. suggested async example:
```py
async with client.chat.stream(model='redwood-large', messages=msgs) as s:
    async for part in s:
        process(part)  # keep memory small
```
and show how to stop early with `await s.aclose()`
adrian: Go snippet: people expect a channel + ctx cancellation pattern. proposed:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.ChatStream(ctx, params)
for {
  msg, err := stream.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { /* retry / backoff */ }
  handle(msg)
}
```
mira: nice — please include a short paragraph about retry jitter (recommended backoff: expo base 200ms, max 10s, +- jitter) and point to the Optimize page for quantization/batching tradeoffs.
kai: also found a tiny bug in existing docs: the TS streaming example used `stream()` then `stream.read()` which doesn't match SDK shape. I'll push a fix in the PR.
jen: CI note — docs linter flags must-statement length in the code comment blocks. trimmed comments in the examples to pass.
deploy-bot: docs-site build started for PR #2145.
deploy-bot: docs-site build failed — linkcheck: found broken link to /guides/old-pagination.
mira: thanks — I'll update the link to /docs/guides/pagination and add a redirect note.
adrian: can we add a tiny integration test that validates the TS example compiles? even a smoke transpile step would catch these.
kai: good idea. I added a package.json script `npm run check-examples` that runs `tsc --noEmit` on snippets/ts. pushed to the PR.
mira: awesome. once the build passes I'll merge and tag in release notes under "docs: streaming & pagination examples clarified". assigning reviewers: @kai, @jen, @adrian.
jen: :thumbsup: later today I'll test the Python example against a dev instance to confirm streaming stops properly when closed.
mira: perfect — ping here when green and I'll merge. thanks y'all!
